description: Compare two tables and report what changed. Works across different databases: both sides compute the same canonical row hash, so only hashes are compared, never raw data. Returns added, removed and modified rows, schema differences, a risk verdict, and the segments of data where the changes concentrate.

columns.description: Columns to compare. Defaults to every column the two tables share.

key_columns.description: Columns used to match rows across the two sides.

max_attributions.description: Maximum number of attribution segments to return. Defaults to 5.

max_changes.description: Maximum number of row changes to return. Defaults to 100.

sample.description: Compare only a sample of rows. The result is marked as sampled.

where.description: A WHERE expression applied to both sides.

name: dataparity_diff
